0022600204.text: The Cavaliers (5-5, on a one-game losing streak, 2nd in the Central and 2 games back, 7th in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-7, on a six-game losing streak, 4th in the Southeast and 3.5 games back, 10th in the East) for Cleveland's 11th game of the season. Cleveland is 1-3 on the road and Charlotte is 2-4 at home, and Jaylon Tyson is out for Cleveland with an ankle sprain, while Jarrett Allen (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For Charlotte, Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) are out, Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have no games yet this season, though the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat the Hornets 118-113 in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
